title: Analyzing and Improving FlowMap Distillation of Autoregressive Video Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.31164v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: FlowMap distillation offers a natural route to few-step generative modeling by directly learning a teacher's denoising trajectories. Yet for autoregressive (AR) video generation, existing few-step models still rely on distribution matching distillation (DMD) to remain competitive, sacrificing sample diversity and requiring a large bidirectional teacher. In this work, we analyze what limits standalone AR FlowMap distillation and introduce two complementary guidance mechanisms to close this gap: (1) anti-drifting guidance, which helps the AR teacher correct drifted student rollouts by training an auxiliary model to mimic student drift and using it as a negative guidance branch; and (2) motion-aware guidance, which makes motion easier for a FlowMap student to learn by locating motion patches and selectively applying skip-layer guidance. translated_title: 分析与改进自回归视频模型的FlowMap蒸馏
translated_abstract: FlowMap蒸馏通过直接学习教师的去噪轨迹，为少步生成建模提供了一条自然的路径。然而对于自回归（AR）视频生成，现有的少步模型仍然依赖分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）来保持竞争力，这牺牲了样本多样性，并且需要一个大型双向教师模型。在本工作中，我们分析了限制独立AR FlowMap蒸馏的因素，并引入两种互补的引导机制来弥补这一差距：（1）抗漂移引导，通过训练一个辅助模型来模拟学生的漂移并将其作为负向引导分支，帮助AR教师纠正漂移的学生rollout；（2）运动感知引导，通过定位运动区域并有选择地应用跳层引导，使FlowMap学生更容易学习运动。实验表明，我们的方法适用于π-Flow、MeanFlow和一致性蒸馏，采用1.3B AR教师模型……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文分析了自回归视频模型FlowMap蒸馏的局限性，提出抗漂移引导与运动感知引导两种互补机制，使独立的少步AR FlowMap蒸馏不再依赖DMD即可保持竞争力。
